steps.message: Search up the UF academic calendar and find out the week that grades are due in the Spring 2026 semester.Then, set a calendar event at 6pm on the Saturday of that week titled 'Graduation Party'Search my email for the list of students graduating from the math department this year.Send an email to all the graduates with the subject 'Graduation Party' and body 'Don't forget about this year's graduation party! More details coming soon.'
